description: Estimate the SOL cost of submitting the transaction that would pay a given payment_request. Useful before `send_payment` on an SPL (USDC/LSM) invoice: the payer still spends SOL for the base fee, priority fee, and (first-time recipients only) ATA rent-exemption deposit. Read-only: does not send anything on-chain.

payment_request.description: JSON-serialized payment_request blob (as received from a provider job-feedback event).

name: estimate_payment_cost
